title: Rabbi Yirmiyah the Southerner
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: Mentioned in Terumot 2:4, according to Seder HaDorot. Maskil LeEitan criticized that reading. On this interpretation, Rabbi Yirmiyah says the southerners, Rabbi Yochanan and Resh Lakish all hold one view.

notes.text: דרומאי is plural, “southerners,” not a single man Dromai. The criticism concerns reading this group designation as Yirmiyah’s epithet. The finite Terumot 2:4 lookup failed to resolve; it supplies no positive evidence.

The consulted Guggenheimer edition has the passage at Terumot 2:2 and places Dromaya immediately after Yirmiyah in the group of three. Earlier in that paragraph the southerners speak as a group. Hyman cites 2:4 and presents Maskil LeEitan’s criticism of the epithet reading.
